**Finding: deviation (Section 19.2, paragraph p0076)**

The warranty package is largely sound — §19.1 (professional/workmanlike, conformity to documentation), §19.3 (no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law), §19.4 (re-perform/repair/replace, then refund), and §19.5 which expressly stops the disclaimer from swallowing express warranties.

The single material failure is duration: §19.2 limits the Deliverable conformity warranty to **fifteen days** after delivery and then extinguishes any correction or refund obligation, which effectively guts the §19.1 conformity warranty too. That is below the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services) and expires roughly when the fifteen-business-day acceptance window in §6.1 closes, so we get no post-acceptance protection.

Redline validated (ok:true): 90 days, with the §19.4 remedy preserved for nonconformities reported in the period.
